z-m-32-02.title: Ingaba umthetho 'phindaphinda iziqeshana ufumane −1' uchaza yonke into ngemigca emile nkqo?
z-m-32-02.topic: Imigca emile nkqo nemveliso yeziqeshana zayo
z-m-32-02.goal: Sebenzisa imizekelo ukuhlola ukuba umthetho othi 'ukuba imigca imile nkqo, imveliso yeziqeshana zayo yi-−1' usetyenziswa kuphela xa yomibini imigca inazo iziqeshana, uze uthelekise iindlela zokuhlola ezibandakanya nemigca engenaziqeshana.
z-m-32-02.material: U-Minseo wafingqa ngolu hlobo: "Ukuba imigca emibini imile nkqo, imveliso yeziqeshana zayo yi-−1. Ngoko ukuba imveliso ayiyi-−1, ayimile nkqo." U-Doyun wabuza, "Ngoko umgca ume ngqo x=2 kunye nomgca othe tye y=3 ayinakuphindaphindwa iziqeshana zayo, ngoko ayimile nkqo, andibi?" Cinga ukuba yonke imigca ibhekisa ngqo ingapheli kumacala omabini, kwaye iiyunithi kwiaxis zee-coordinate ziyafana. (x=2 ngumgca apho ixabiso le-x lihlala li-2, umgca ume ngqo ofana ne-y-axis. y=3 ngumgca othe tye ofana ne-x-axis.)

z-m-32-01.title: Kuxelwe amanqaku amathathu, ingaba incopho yesine yeyodwa kuphela?
z-m-32-01.goal: Sebenzisa ii-coordinates ukuhlola ukuba, kwi-parallelogram enamanqaku amathathu anikiweyo, kusenokubakho iincopho ezininzi zesine ngokuxhomekeke kwinqaku elichasene nalo, uze ucacise ukuba kutshintsha ntoni xa amanqaku amathathu akumgca omnye.
z-m-32-01.material: Kumphezulu we-coordinate kukho amanqaku amathathu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(1, 3). Ufuna ukwenza i-parallelogram enala manqaku amathathu nenye inqaku D njengeencopho. Ulandelelwano lwamagama eencopho aluxhonyiwe. Oko kukuthi, D inokuchasana nayiphi na kwi-A, B, okanye C. U-Hayun wafumana D=(5, 4) waza wathi, "Eli lilo lodwa inqaku lesine elinokwenzeka." (I-parallelogram yimilo apho onke amanqaku amane engekho kumgca omnye. Isikwere esinye segridi sinobude obufanayo kuyo yonke icala.)

z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.a: Esi sigwebo sicinga ukuba xa amanqaku amathathu emiselwe, elokugqibela nalo limiselwe. Kodwa ingaba ingxaki yathi D ichasene nawuphi na?

z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.b: Esi sisigwebo esithi amanqaku amabini kuphela anokuchasana. Bala ukuba mangaphi kuma-A, B, C anokuchasana ne-D.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.c: Zonke ii-coordinates zinikiwe, ngoko unokubala inani. Ungacinga ukuba lingatshintsha njani ukuba iindawo zamanqaku zahlukile.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.o.d: Kukho amanqaku ama-3 apho D inokuba khona
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.d: Esi sisigwebo esenziwe ngokubala ngelixa kutshintsha inqaku elichasene ne-D. Kwinyathelo elingezantsi, siza kuzenza ngokwethu ukuhlola ukuba eli nani lichanekile na.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuba amanqaku amathathu akekho kumgca omnye, imeko apho D ichasene no-A, imeko apho ichasene no-B, neyo apho ichasene no-C inganye yenza i-parallelogram enye, ngoko zi-3. (5, 4) yenye kuzo. Kwinyathelo elilandelayo uya kuzakha wena ukuhlola.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.prompt: Faka ii-coordinates ezi-3 ezahlukileyo (x, y) ze-D. Amanqaku wona kuphela enza i-parallelogram kunye no-A, B, no-C ayamkelwa. (I-(5, 4) ka-Hayun ibalwa njengenye yazo.)
z-m-32-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba umfanekiso odibanisa amanqaku amane no-D=(5, 4) ka-Hayun, uze ufumane ukuba ngowuphi kuma-A, B, C ochasene no-D.

z-m-32-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba D ichasene no-A yi-(5, 4), ukuba ichasene no-B yi-(−3, 2), kwaye ukuba ichasene no-C yi-(3, −2). Kuzo zontathu iimeko, amacandelo amabini omgca adibanisa iibini ezimbini zeencopho ezichasanayo adibana kwiindawo zawo ezingaphakathi.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba amanqaku amathathu akumgca omnye, njenge-A(0, 0), P(1, 1), Q(2, 2), zingaphi iindawo ezinokwenzeka ze-D? Bhala inani nesizathu kwisivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini.

z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba amanqaku amathathu akumgca omnye, nokuba uyibeka phi i-D awukwazi ukwenza i-parallelogram. Amanqaku amathathu kufuneka enze unxantathu ukuze iimeko ezi-3, ezitshintsha inqaku elichasene, ziviwe.

z-m-32-03.title: Ulingano lwesangqa esihanjisiweyo lubonakala lungalunganga: lubhadle phi?
z-m-32-03.goal: Fumana impazamo kwisisombululo sembonakalo yesilingano sesimo esihanjisiweyo, apho icala lokuhamba lasetyenziswa ngokuphambeneyo, uze wahlule ukujonga okunokuvula impazamo kokungenakuyivula.
z-m-32-03.material: U-Seoyun wasombulula ulingano lwesangqa C: (x+1)²+(y−2)²=9 esihanjiswe nge-+3 kwicala le-x nge--4 kwicala le-y, njengoko kuboniswe ngezantsi. (+3 kwicala le-x kuthetha iiyunithi ezi-3 ngasekunene, kwaye -4 kwicala le-y kuthetha iiyunithi ezi-4 ezantsi. Umthetho wokuhambisa ichaphaza elinye ngowokuba (x, y) iye ku-(x+3, y−4). Ulingano lwesangqa C lufundwa 'x kudityaniswe 1 isikwere kudityaniswe y ukususa 2 isikwere kulingana ne-9'.)

z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.0: Fumana ulingano lwesimo esifunyenwe ngokuhambisa isangqa C nge-+3 kwicala le-x nge--4 kwicala le-y.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.1: Xa ichaphaza (x, y) lesimo lihanjiswa, liba yi-(x+3, y−4), ngoko tshintshela x nge-x+3 kwaye y nge-y−4 kulingano.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.explain: Iphosakele kumgca wesi-2. Ichaphaza (X, Y) lesimo esihanjisiweyo lichaphaza (X−3, Y+4) lesimo sokuqala esihambileyo, ngoko X−3 no-Y+4 kufuneka zingene kwindawo ye-x ne-y kulingano lokuqala. Ulingano luka-Seoyun luthumela iziko ku-(−4, 6), kodwa ukuhambisa iziko lokuqala (−1, 2) nge-(+3, −4) kunika (2, −2). Ukujonga: ichaphaza (−1, 5) kwisangqa C lihamba liye ku-(2, 1), kwaye ukubeka eli chaphaza kulingano olutsha luka-Seoyun kunika 6²+(−5)²=61, hayi i-9. Imigca 3 ukuya kwesi-5 ilandela nje kwisiphumo somgca wesi-2.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.prompt: Emva kokuba u-Seoyun egqiba isisombululo, ngawaphi amakheck anokunceda ukuqaphela impazamo ngoko nangoko? Khetha onke amakheck anokuvula ngokwenene impazamo kwesi sisombululo.

z-m-32-03.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba impazamo imalunga nendawo okanye ubungakanani, uze uthelekise ukuba ikheck nganye ijonga elo xabiso.

z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.a: Kwesi sisombululo irediyasi ifana nangaphambili, ngoko le kheck yodwa ayivuli mpazamo. Cinga ukuba le kheck ijonga isimo sesimo okanye indawo yaso.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.b: Hambisa iziko lesangqa C ngomthetho ofanayo uze uthelekise neziko kulingano olutsha
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.b: Le ngcamango kukubala indawo emva kokuhamba ngqo ngomthetho wokuhamba uze uthelekise.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.c: Andisa ulingano olutsha ujonge ukuba iikoyifishenti ze-x² ne-y² zisayi-1 zombini
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.c: Iikoyifishenti azitshintshi phantsi kokuhambisa, ngoko zihlala zifana nakwisisombululo esingalunganga. Le kheck ayijongi icala okanye ubungakanani bokuhamba.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.d: Hambisa ichaphaza elinye kwisangqa C ngomthetho ofanayo uze ulibeke kulingano olutsha ujonge ukuba liyahambelana
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.d: Le ngcamango kukuvavanya ngqo ukuba ichaphaza apho ichaphaza lesimo sokuqala lihamba khona lanelisa ulingano olutsha.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.explain: Ulingano olutsha luka-Seoyun lunerediyasi efanayo neekoyifishenti ezifanayo ze-x² ne-y² njengangaphambili, ngoko iikheck a no-c ziyadlula. Impazamo isendaweni emva kokuhamba, ngoko iikheck b no-d, ezihambisa iziko okanye ichaphaza elisesimweni ngomthetho ofanayo zithelekise nolingano olutsha, zivula impazamo.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.prompt: Uhambise isangqa C nge-p kwicala le-x nge-q kwicala le-y (irediyasi isahlala ingu-3 emva kokuhamba), kwaye saba sisangqa esidlula kwimvelaphi (0, 0). Ngenisa (p, q) ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenzeka. (Amadesimali ayavunyelwa.)
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala iziko elitsha, eliziko (−1, 2) lesangqa C elihanjiswe nge-p kunye ne-q, ngokwe-p ne-q.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa kwiziko elitsha nakwimvelaphi inyani yokuba onke amachaphaza kwisangqa akumgama othe tye ukusuka kwiziko.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Isangqa esihanjisiweyo asidluli kwimvelaphi. Bhala iziko elitsha ngokwe-p ne-q ujonge umgama ukuya kwimvelaphi.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.explain: Iziko elitsha li-(−1+p, 2+q), kwaye ukuze imvelaphi ibe kwisangqa, umgama phakathi kwemvelaphi neziko elitsha kufuneka ube yirediyasi engu-3. Oko kukuthi, (p−1)²+(q+2)²=9. Izisombululo eziiinteger zi-(4, −2), (−2, −2), (1, 1), (1, −5), kwaye kukho nezisombululo zedesimali. Kwindlela yokuhamba (3, −4) kwingxaki yantlandlolo, iziko elitsha li-(2, −2), kwaye umgama walo ukusuka kwimvelaphi yi-√8, ngoko isangqa asidluli kwimvelaphi.

z-m-32-04.title: Ingaba ulwazi 'luchukumisana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela' lwanela?
z-m-32-04.topic: Indawo yezangqa ezimbini nomgama phakathi kwamaziko azo
z-m-32-04.goal: Funda ukuba ulwazi lokuba izangqa ezimbini zidibana kwichaphaza elinye alugqibi umgama phakathi kwamaziko ube lixabiso elinye, uthi sisiphi ulwazi olongezelelweyo olufunekayo, uze uchaze uluhlu lwemigama apho zidibana kumachaphaza amabini.
z-m-32-04.material: Ibhedi yeentyatyambo ejikelezileyo A inaziko layo kwimvelaphi O(0, 0) kunye nerediyasi engu-3 (iyunithi: m). Njengolingano, yi-x²+y²=9. Ibhedi B isisangqa esinerediyasi engu-5 (iyunithi: m), kwaye indawo yeziko layo ayikagqitywa. Icebo lithi 'imigca yemida yeebhedi zeentyatyambo ezimbini idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela' kuphela. U-Jion uthe, "Zichukumisana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela, ngoko umgama d phakathi kwamaziko amabini ngu-3+5=8." (Cinga umda njengomgca ongenabukhulu. Ukuba izangqa ezimbini zikude, okanye ukuba isangqa esinye silele ngokupheleleyo ngaphakathi kwesinye, imigca yemida yazo ayidibani.)

z-m-32-04.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba ulwazi 'imigca yemida idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela' lunokulungisa d ibe lixabiso elinye? Khetha isigwebo esifanelekileyo kakhulu.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba isangqa esinerediyasi engu-3, emva koko uzobe umfanekiso omnye onesangqa esinerediyasi engu-5 sichukumisa sivela ngaphandle nomnye sichukumisa sivela ngaphakathi.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kumfanekiso ngamnye, bhala ubude uze uthelekise ukuba umgama phakathi kwamaziko amabini unxulumene njani nemiradiyasi emibini.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.a: Idinokwenzeka d yi-8 okanye i-2, amaxabiso amabini, ngoko ayigqitywa njengenye
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.a: Esi sisigwebo esacinga ukuba indlela yokuchukumisa yahlukana ibe ziindlela ezimbini.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.b: Esi sisigwebo esacinga kuphela ngetyala apho izangqa ezimbini zichukumisana ukusuka ngaphandle. Zoba ukuba ityala apho isangqa esinye sichukumisa esinye ukusuka ngaphakathi nalo lidibana kwichaphaza elinye.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo sicinge kuphela ngetyala apho isangqa esincinci sichukumisa isangqa esikhulu ukusuka ngaphakathi. Izangqa ezichukumisana ukusuka ngaphandle nazo zidibana kwichaphaza elinye.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.d: Kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi, ngoko awukwazi ukuxela ixabiso le-d
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.d: Isigwebo sokuba kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi sivumelekile. Kodwa cinga ukuba ungaxela na nokuba sisiphi ulwazi olufunekayo kwaye, ngokuxhomekeke kulo, ngowuphi kumaxabiso amangaphi d iya kuba nguwo.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.explain: Zikho iimeko ezimbini apho izangqa ezimbini zidibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela. Ukuba zichukumisana ukusuka ngaphandle, d=3+5=8, kwaye ukuba isangqa esincinci A sichukumisa ngaphakathi kwesangqa esikhulu B, d=5−3=2. Ngoko ufuna ukwazi ngakumbi 'ngendlela ezichukumisana ngayo' ukuze d ilungiswe ibe lixabiso elinye.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.acc.0: Isiphelo sokuba ulwazi alwanelanga silungile. Ukuya ngaphaya kwenyathelo elinye, ukuba uyazi 'ukuba zichukumisana ukusuka ngaphandle okanye ngaphakathi', d ilungiswe ibe yi-8 okanye i-2.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.prompt: Gqiba iziko (x, y) lebhedi B uze wenze ulungiselelo apho imigca yemida emibini idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela. Ugqibile xa ungenisa ulungiselelo olubini apho imigama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kwiziko le-B yahlukileyo.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isikwere somgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kwiziko ngokwe-x ne-y.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kuqala gqiba umgama kwimeko nganye yezimbini apho zidibana kwichaphaza elinye, uze ukhethe ichaphaza elinye kumgama ngamnye.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Imigca yemida emibini idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ngeli ziko, imigca yemida emibini ayidibani kwichaphaza elinye (ayidibani, okanye idibana kumachaphaza amabini). Thelekisa umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kwiziko nemiradiyasi emibini.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuba umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kwiziko ngu-8, zichukumisana ukusuka ngaphandle (umzekelo (8, 0)), kwaye ukuba ngu-2, zichukumisana ukusuka ngaphakathi (umzekelo (0, 2)). Ukuba imigama iyalingana (umzekelo (8, 0) kunye ne-(0, 8)), luhlobo olufanayo lolungiselelo, ngoko zibale njengolunye.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.prompt: Cinga ngokunyusa d kancinci kancinci ukusuka ku-0. Bhala uluhlu lwe-d apho imigca yemida emibini idibana kumachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba luluhlu olo usebenzisa indlela enye. (Chaza ngamagama endaweni yomfanekiso.)
z-m-32-04.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa imigama yolungiselelo oluhlu lomibini owalwenza kwinyathelo lesi-2 njengerefensi, zoba ngokuqikelela indlela izangqa ezimbini ezilele ngayo kwimigama ephakathi kwazo nakwimigama engaphandle kwazo.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ngokwahlukileyo ukuba izangqa ezimbini ziyachukumisana na xa d ingaphantsi kwe-2 nalapho d ingaphezulu kwe-8.

z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndithethile ukuba iziphelo zombini zoluhlu apho zidibana kumachaphaza amabini (d=2, d=8) aziquki?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndichaze ukuba imigca yemida emibini ibonakala njani xa d ingaphantsi kwe-2 nalapho d ingaphezulu kwe-8?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba isizathu endasibhalayo sinokufikelela kumfundi nokuba akukho mfanekiso?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.model.0: Xa 2<d<8, zidibana kumachaphaza amabini. Ukuba d=2 zichukumisana kwichaphaza elinye ukusuka ngaphakathi, kwaye ukuba d=8 zichukumisana kwichaphaza elinye ukusuka ngaphandle, ngoko phakathi, izangqa ezimbini ziyagqubuzana ngokunqumlana kwaye zidibana kumachaphaza amabini.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.model.1: Kukho xa d ingaphezulu komahluko wemiradiyasi emibini, 5−3=2, kwaye incinci kunesixa sayo, 3+5=8. Ukuba d ingaphezulu kwesixa, zikude, kwaye ukuba incinci kunomahluko, isangqa esincinci sisemva kwesangqa esikhulu, ngoko aziidibani.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ichaza amaxabiso omda isebenzisa umahluko nesixa semiradiyasi.
